title: Moral Entropy: Auditing Bias and Uncertainty in Moral Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2609.21992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most work in computational ethics treats annotator disagreement on moral content as noise to be voted away, collapsed into majority vote or the more permissive any-annotator rule the moment a single annotator flags an item. We argue this uncertainty should instead be modeled and learned from.   We introduce Moral Entropy, a Bayesian framework that keeps a full posterior over the true label and decomposes its entropy into aleatoric uncertainty (irreducible disagreement about the moral content) and epistemic uncertainty (from insufficient or noisy annotation) -- and lets any heuristic consensus rule be audited against a calibrated ground truth via entropy methods such as cross-entropy/KL, Brier score, and expected calibration error. translated_title: 道德熵：审计道德判断中的偏差与不确定性
translated_abstract: 计算伦理学中的大多数工作将标注者在道德内容上的分歧视为需要通过投票消除的噪声，一旦有单个标注者标记某项内容，就将其坍缩为多数投票或更宽松的“任一标注者”规则。我们认为这种不确定性应当被建模并从中学习。我们提出了道德熵，这是一个贝叶斯框架，保留真实标签的完整后验分布，并将其熵分解为偶然不确定性（关于道德内容的不可约分歧）和认知不确定性（来自不充分或有噪声的标注）——并通过熵方法（如交叉熵/KL散度、Brier分数和期望校准误差），使任何启发式共识规则都能对照校准的真实标准进行审计。在三个语料库和十五个话语领域中，对照此后验分布审计标准聚合规则，揭示了当前没有任何流程报告的偏差：“任一标注者”规则与校准的……
tldr: 提出道德熵贝叶斯框架，将道德标注中的不确定性分解为偶然不确定性与认知不确定性，并利用熵方法审计标准共识规则中隐藏的偏差。
en_tdlr: Proposes Moral Entropy, a Bayesian framework that decomposes moral annotation uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components, enabling entropy-based auditing of hidden biases in standard consensus rules.
